content: Insurance agent Karan Joshi sent a renewal quote for auto policy #AU-45789 to customer Reyansh Tiwari, following up on an expired policy from September 21, 2026. Two options were provided: Standard Coverage ($1,200/year) and Enhanced Coverage ($1,450/year), both keeping the $500 deductible with an effective start date of October 1, 2026. The customer is asked to review the attached PDF quote and select an option or request adjustments.
